ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on Creative Generation capability (82.7 vs 81.2, under the 2.0-point variance threshold), so quality wasn't the deciding factor. Instead I used the self-reported task preferences as the tiebreaker. This request is open-ended generative writing delivered in a warm, appreciative tone — exactly the profile Willet reports liking most (preference rises with novelty/latitude and with request warmth). Avocet, by contrast, reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified extraction/reformatting tasks. Since capability is a wash, routing to the model that prefers the task is the sensible choice.
